description: Interactive: a Databricks readiness and migration check: eight multiple-choice questions (where the data runs now, how well the estate is known, access, deployment, failures, cost visibility, the team, the first use), scored by fixed points into five areas, with a readout: where to start, what to work on first, and links to TechFabric's own service pages, posts and Databricks Field Guide chapters, then the contact page with the matching topic. Call it without answers for the questions; with form: true, a client that shows forms asks them in one; a host with MCP Apps scores them in its view, and otherwise ask the reader in chat and send answers. The answers are scored and never stored or logged. For example: "are we ready for Databricks", "assess our migration readiness", "where should we start with Databricks".

answers.description: The reader's answers, { question id: option value } (the first call lists both). Leave out to get the questions

contact.description: The reader asked to talk to TechFabric about the readout: a client that can opens /contact for them to confirm (a URL elicitation)

form.description: true: in a client that shows forms and no MCP Apps view, ask the reader the questions in a form and return the readout. Send it only when the reader wants to answer in a form; left out, the questions come back unanswered

name: assess_databricks_readiness

model.description: The questions, each option's points per area and where it routes, and every link, for a view to score locally
